title: Identify the state abbreviations where, for both male and female legislator
question: Identify the state abbreviations where, for both male and female legislators, the retention rate remains greater than zero at specific intervals of 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10 years after their first term start date. A legislator is considered retained if they are serving on December 31 of the respective year. Only include states where both gender cohorts maintain non-zero retention rates at all six of these time points during the first decade of service.

prediction.sql:
WITH first_term AS (
  SELECT id_bioguide, MIN(term_start) AS fs
  FROM legislators_terms
  GROUP BY id_bioguide
),
base AS (
  SELECT t.id_bioguide, t.state, l.gender,
         (CAST(substr(t.term_start,1,4) AS INTEGER) - CAST(substr(f.fs,1,4) AS INTEGER)) AS yr
  FROM legislators_terms t
  JOIN first_term f ON t.id_bioguide = f.id_bioguide
  JOIN legislators l ON l.id_bioguide = t.id_bioguide
  WHERE t.term_end IS NOT NULL
    AND t.term_end != ''
    AND t.term_end >= (substr(f.fs,1,4) || '-12-31')
    AND t.term_start <= (substr(f.fs,1,4) || '-12-31')
),
ret AS (
  SELECT state, gender, yr, COUNT(DISTINCT id_bioguide) AS c
  FROM base
  WHERE yr IN (0,2,4,6,8,10)
  GROUP BY state, gender, yr
),
cov AS (
  SELECT state, gender, COUNT(DISTINCT yr) AS n, MIN(CASE WHEN c=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_zero
  FROM ret
  GROUP BY state, gender
)
SELECT state
FROM cov
GROUP BY state
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN gender='M' AND n=6 AND has_zero=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)=1
   AND SUM(CASE WHEN gender='F' AND n=6 AND has_zero=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)=1
ORDER BY state

persistent_recovery_advisory_draft.base_sql:
WITH first_term AS (
  SELECT id_bioguide, state, MIN(term_start) AS fs
  FROM legislators_terms
  GROUP BY id_bioguide, state
),
base AS (
  SELECT l.id_bioguide, l.gender, ft.state, ft.fs,
         (julianday(strftime('%Y', ft.fs) || '-12-31') - julianday(ft.fs)) / 365.25 AS yrs
  FROM legislators l
  JOIN first_term ft ON l.id_bioguide = ft.id_bioguide
),
retained AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT b.gender, b.state, b.yrs
  FROM base b
  JOIN legislators_terms t ON t.id_bioguide = b.id_bioguide
  WHERE t.term_start <= b.fs || ' ' || '12-31'
    AND (t.term_end IS NULL OR t.term_end >= b.fs || ' ' || '12-31')
)
SELECT state
FROM (
  SELECT state, gender,
         SUM(CASE WHEN yrs BETWEEN 0 AND 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS c0,
         SUM(CASE WHEN yrs BETWEEN 2 AND 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS c2,
         SUM(CASE WHEN yrs BETWEEN 4 AND 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS c4,
         SUM(CASE WHEN yrs BETWEEN 6 AND 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS c6,
         SUM(CASE WHEN yrs BETWEEN 8 AND 9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS c8,
         SUM(CASE WHEN yrs BETWEEN 10 AND 11 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS c10
  FROM retained
  GROUP BY state, gender
)
GROUP BY state
HAVING MIN(c0) > 0 AND MIN(c2) > 0 AND MIN(c4) > 0 AND MIN(c6) > 0 AND MIN(c8) > 0 AND MIN(c10) > 0
ORDER BY state;
